summary:
Highlights
• Dynamic and results-driven Project Manager with over 16 years of
experience in managing Salesforce Software Solutions, managing project
processes & project planning, and driving strategic business improvements.
• Proven expertise in translating business requirements into technical
solutions, optimizing workflows, and enhancing user experience. Adept at
leading cross-functional teams, managing complex projects, and ensuring
high-quality deliverables.
• Bring a fresh perspective and challenge the status quo while considering the
nuances of the systems.
• Business Domain: HRMS, Insurance, Tax, Loan, Mortgage, AgriTech,
Events, Ecommerce.
• NOTABLE HIGHLIGHTS ACROSS THE CAREER:
• Group Manager for four- five major Tax domain projects for US client.
• Project Planning, Costing. Capacity Planning, Estimations.
• HRMS tools – Darwin Box, Success Factor and Cranium experience almost 7 years.
• Generative AI tools
• CLM tool Docusign
• Worked on Salesforce Platform, Kentico-CMS tool, and UI Path RPA
Automation
• Certified RPA Developer -UI Path · Expertise in managing full project
management life cycle for implementing highly complex, large-scale,
strategic IT and business initiatives
• Work closely with stakeholders/clients, for understanding the system’s
functional and non-functional requirements in defining the Product Vision
• Demonstrate leadership abilities with the deployment of software upgrades,
enhancements and fixes that are coordinated based on release schedules
• Provide a software development plan that meets the future needs of
stakeholders/clients, based on the state-of-the-art technologies
• Coordinate release and sprint planning, Conduct daily scrum meetings
• Coached developers resolve both technical problems as well as human
resources issues
• Provide leadership and guidance to coach, motivate, and lead team members
to their optimum performance levels and career development
• Preparing important technical documentations like Project Planner, RFP,
Team Composition Matrix, Sprint Planner, Risk Registers, Burn Down Charts,
Status Dashboards, Go Live Approvals etc.

Managing Agile Framework in the Project and maintaining Agile Ceremonies.

Liaise with business stakeholders, product owners, and vendors to gather requirements and provide updates.

User Enablement & Support

Set up dashboards and reports for performance tracking, case resolution SLAs, and marketing KPIs.
Foster change management and adoption across departments.
Compliance & Quality Assurance

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Use feedback loops and analytics to refine customer experiences and streamline processes.

Also Managed Company’s inhouse HR Resource Allocation tool Cranium which briefs about how resources are onboarded, Earmarked and Allocated to the projects. End to End Resource Cycle from onboarding to releasing project/organization.

Synopsis: PROVAR is the Automation tool for Salesforce using Selenium Web driver on the Backend. PROVAR supports no code automation testing for Salesforce. Platform & Tools Used were Salesforce, Selenium Web Driver Roles and Responsibilities:
Project Planning & Governance
Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones for Provar automation initiatives.
Define project scope, success criteria, risk management strategies, and resource allocation.
Set up governance frameworks, communication plans, and sprint planning routines (Agile/Scrum/Kanban).
Stakeholder & Client Management
Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, QA leads, and Salesforce delivery teams.
Gather automation requirements from stakeholders and align them with Provar testing capabilities.
Facilitate regular status meetings, executive briefings, and reporting dashboards.
Team Coordination & Resource Management
Manage cross-functional teams including Provar automation engineers, Salesforce developers, manual QA testers, and DevOps resources.
Oversee resource planning, skill alignment, and training enablement for Provar tool usage.
Project/Client Name: CSN- Cvent Supplier Network.
Salesforce CSN Solution Ownership
Lead the end-to-end implementation and enhancement of the Customer Success Network (CSN) module within Salesforce.
Align CSN capabilities with Cvent’s customer lifecycle workflows—support tickets, onboarding, health scoring, renewal tracking, and escalations.
Customize Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud to support CSN-specific use cases.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with Customer Success, Account Management, Support, and Product teams to gather requirements and optimize CSN flows.
Act as a bridge between business teams and technical resources, translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
Project Management & Delivery
Own project planning, sprint execution, backlog grooming, and delivery timelines for CSN projects.
Ensure agile project execution, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, UAT cycles, and retrospectives.
Track and report project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery status to leadership and stakeholders.
sub_sections: Synopsis: Cvent Supplier Network (CSN) is a platform for both the event planners as well as for the Suppliers (Venues and
Services) to work mutually to conduct an event. The process involves the management of sending RFP from planners to
Supplier’s and then the response of Supplier’s in the form of Proposals back to the Event Planners.
